if: the supply is a supply of goods
tax is NOT paid or liable to be paid on reverse charge basis
then: the time of supply is the EARLIER of the two dates in s.12(2)(a) and s.12(2)(b) — see GST-TIME-GOODS-002 and GST-TIME-GOODS-003
note: EARLIER, not later, and not the accounting recognition date. s.12(1) ties the liability itself to this date, so the date chosen here is the date the tax becomes payable.

evidence.quote: The liability to pay tax on goods shall arise at the time of supply, as determined in accordance with the provisions of this                    section.
